lines.zh: 我四肢着地，尾巴拖在后面。
lines.en: I walk on all fours, my tail dragging behind.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地挪，像青蛙。
lines.en: I move in little hops, like a frog.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯亮了，我就贴墙走。
lines.en: The corridor lights come on, so I hug the wall.

lines.zh: 我爬过通风口，灰落了一身。
lines.en: I crawl through the vent and dust settles on me.

lines.zh: 我手脚并用，指节敲着铁板。
lines.en: I scramble on hands and feet, knuckles rapping the iron.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，只有尾尖扫地。
lines.en: My steps are light; only my tail tip sweeps the floor.

lines.zh: 实验区的门都开过，我记得。
lines.en: Every door in the lab has opened; I remember them.

lines.zh: 我沿着柜子走，一间一间看。
lines.en: I walk along the cabinets, checking one room at a time.

lines.zh: 我停下来，歪头听箱子里的回声。
lines.en: I stop and tilt my head to the echo inside a chest.

lines.zh: 我短腿跑起来，声音像拍水。
lines.en: My short legs patter like hands slapping water.

lines.zh: 我钻进桌下，从另一头出来。
lines.en: I duck under the desk and come out the other side.

lines.zh: 我走三步，就回头确认没人。
lines.en: Every three steps I turn to check that no one follows.

lines.zh: 我蹲在角落，喉咙里发闷笑。
lines.en: I crouch in the corner, a muffled giggle in my throat.

lines.zh: 箱子里很黑，我很喜欢。
lines.en: The chest is dark, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我抱着自己的尾巴，轻轻摇。
lines.en: I hug my own tail and rock it gently.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在地板上刮了刮。
lines.en: My nails scrape once across the floor.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人走近到三步。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone to come within three paces.

lines.zh: 闷笑从箱缝里漏出去。
lines.en: A stifled giggle leaks through the chest's gap.

lines.zh: 我不怕黑，我怕没人来。
lines.en: I do not fear the dark; I fear no one coming.

lines.zh: 我把自己叠成很小的一团。
lines.en: I fold myself into a very small bundle.

lines.zh: 头顶的管子在滴水，我抬头。
lines.en: A pipe drips overhead; I look up.

lines.zh: 我记住每个箱子放的位置。
lines.en: I remember where every chest sits.

lines.zh: 我从箱缝里看你，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I watch you through the chest gap with one eye.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的笑就停了。
lines.en: You come closer, and my giggle stops.

lines.zh: 我歪头，估你到箱子的距离。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging your distance to the chest.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我往后退。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 你低头找箱子，我先笑了。
lines.en: You look down for a chest, and I laugh first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处反光。
lines.en: My eyes catch the light from the dark.

lines.zh: 你听，那声音是从箱子里来的。
lines.en: Listen, that sound comes from inside the chest.

lines.zh: 我看你时，尾巴慢慢绷直。
lines.en: As I watch you, my tail slowly straightens.

lines.zh: 你数箱子，我在里面数你。
lines.en: You count chests; I count you from inside one.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，等你再近一点。
lines.en: I do not blink, waiting for you to come nearer.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我发出短促的笑。
lines.en: You hit me, and a short giggle escapes.

lines.zh: 我被打得滚进箱子里。
lines.en: The blow rolls me into a chest.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，尾巴盖住脸。
lines.en: I curl up and cover my face with my tail.

lines.zh: 血从我的小臂滴到地上。
lines.en: Blood drips from my forearm to the floor.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，声音比拳头响。
lines.en: I scream once, louder than the punch.

lines.zh: 疼得我四肢乱蹬。
lines.en: The pain makes all four limbs kick.

lines.zh: 你踩住我，我咬你的鞋。
lines.en: You pin me down, so I bite your boot.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤裂了，里面是灰。
lines.en: My skin splits open, grey inside.

lines.zh: 我一边哭一边笑。
lines.en: I cry and giggle at the same time.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想躲回箱子。
lines.en: That one makes me want to hide in a chest.

lines.zh: 你手里的钥匙，我认得形状。
lines.en: I know the shape of the key in your hand.

lines.zh: 你把饼干晃一晃，我没兴趣。
lines.en: You wave a cookie; I am not interested.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你在开箱子。
lines.en: I follow you because you are opening chests.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我全塞进箱里。
lines.en: Whatever you set down, I stuff into a chest.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想收藏。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I only want to keep it.

lines.zh: 你伸手进箱子，我就笑出声。
lines.en: Put your hand in the chest and I laugh out loud.

lines.zh: 你带来的气味，比食物好闻。
lines.en: What you carry smells better than food.

lines.zh: 别把箱盖关死，我会闷。
lines.en: Do not shut the lid tight; I will suffocate.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我的尾巴卷起来。
lines.en: You take one step and my tail curls up.

lines.zh: 我要的不是东西，是箱子里的位置。
lines.en: I want the spot inside the chest, not the thing.

lines.zh: 你撞到箱子，我在里面叫。
lines.en: You bump the chest and I cry out inside.

lines.zh: 箱子盖撞上我的下巴，牙磕响了。
lines.en: The crate lid hits my jaw and my teeth clack.

lines.zh: 我从箱缝里被挤出来，笑岔了气。
lines.en: Squeezed out through the crate seam, I laugh myself breathless.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤又湿又凉，蹭你一手。
lines.en: My skin is cold and damp; it smears your hand.

lines.zh: 你把我踢开，我顺着地滚两圈。
lines.en: You kick me and I roll twice along the floor.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我笑得更大声。
lines.en: The bump makes my giggle louder.

lines.zh: 我贴住你的腿，很滑。
lines.en: I press against your leg, slippery.

lines.zh: 你一推，我就从箱口滑出来。
lines.en: One push and I slide out of the chest mouth.

lines.zh: 我撞上铁柜，尾巴先着地。
lines.en: I hit the iron cabinet and land on my tail.

lines.zh: 你从我身上跨过去，我抬头看你。
lines.en: You step over me; I look up at you.

lines.zh: 两个箱子，我们各占一个。
lines.en: Two chests, and we take one each.

lines.zh: 我们隔着箱壁对笑。
lines.en: We giggle at each other through the chest walls.

lines.zh: 它的笑声比我闷一点。
lines.en: Its giggle is a little more muffled than mine.

lines.zh: 我们挤进同一个柜子。
lines.en: We squeeze into the same cabinet.

lines.zh: 尾尖碰尾尖，就算打过招呼。
lines.en: Tail tip to tail tip counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我们不争，箱子够多。
lines.en: We do not fight; there are chests enough.

lines.zh: 它先笑，我跟着笑。
lines.en: It laughs first, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，等脚步。
lines.en: We crouch side by side, waiting for footsteps.

lines.zh: 它的小手抓住我的尾巴。
lines.en: Its small hand grips my tail.

lines.zh: 一起躲着，比独自躲着好。
lines.en: Hiding together beats hiding alone.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的东西塞进腮帮。
lines.en: I stuff whatever drops into my cheeks.

lines.zh: 你丢的线，我缠在指头上。
lines.en: The string you drop, I wind around a finger.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗糖，闻了闻没吃。
lines.en: I pick up a candy, sniff it, and do not eat it.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我都要藏起来。
lines.en: Anything shiny, I must hide away.

lines.zh: 我拖着比我还大的布走。
lines.en: I drag a cloth larger than myself.

lines.zh: 捡到东西，我就往箱子跑。
lines.en: When I find something, I run to a chest.

lines.zh: 你掉的钥匙，我先咬一口。
lines.en: The key you drop, I bite once first.

lines.zh: 我把玻璃片当成宝。
lines.en: I treat a shard of glass like treasure.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西，全都堆在箱底。
lines.en: Everything I find piles up at the chest's bottom.

lines.zh: 我不还，塞进箱子就关门。
lines.en: I do not give it back; I shut the lid on it.

lines.zh: 你走到八格内，我盯上你了。
lines.en: You come within eight blocks, and I have you.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你一个人。
lines.en: I pick you because you are alone.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就不笑了。
lines.en: You come closer and my giggling stops.

lines.zh: 箱盖掀开一条缝，我看见你。
lines.en: The lid lifts a crack, and I see you.

lines.zh: 目标确定，我的喉咙开始紧。
lines.en: Target set, my throat begins to tighten.

lines.zh: 你站在走廊尽头，正好。
lines.en: You stand at the corridor's end, perfect.

lines.zh: 我记住了你鞋子的声音。
lines.en: I have learned the sound of your shoes.

lines.zh: 你转身时，我已经蹬好后腿。
lines.en: When you turn, my hind legs are already set.

lines.zh: 是你就好，别人我不追。
lines.en: You will do; I do not chase the others.

lines.zh: 我把你归进箱子的那一栏。
lines.en: I file you under the chest column.

lines.zh: 你数箱子的时候，我已经在第三个里了。
lines.en: While you count chests, I am already in the third.

lines.zh: 你回头张望，我从缝里看着你笑。
lines.en: You glance back; I giggle at you through the gap.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的笑就低一分。
lines.en: Each step you take, my giggle drops a note.

lines.zh: 你一停，我就准备跳。
lines.en: The moment you stop, I ready my leap.

lines.zh: 你把手放在箱盖上，我笑了。
lines.en: You put your hand on the lid, and I laughed.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声进了我的房间。
lines.en: Your footsteps have entered my room.

lines.zh: 我在桌下跟着你，一寸一寸。
lines.en: Under the desk I follow you, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，尾巴藏好。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and tuck my tail away.

lines.zh: 你回头，我缩回箱里。
lines.en: You look back, and I pull into the chest.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，始终隔着三步。
lines.en: I circle you, always three paces out.

lines.zh: 你跑，我就从箱顶跳过去。
lines.en: You run; I leap across the chest tops.

lines.zh: 我挤过窄缝，比你快一点。
lines.en: I squeeze through the gap, a little faster than you.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬，指甲刮出细响。
lines.en: I crawl low, nails scraping a thin sound.

lines.zh: 你找门，我堵在箱子后。
lines.en: You look for the door; I wait behind a chest.

lines.zh: 我从暗处看你，笑得很轻。
lines.en: I watch from the dark, giggling softly.

lines.zh: 距离三步，我还没动。
lines.en: Three paces out, and I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我换箱子跟，比你换得快。
lines.en: I switch chests to follow, faster than you switch rooms.

lines.zh: 你听见笑声，却找不到我。
lines.en: You hear the giggle but cannot find me.

lines.zh: 我在柜与柜之间移动。
lines.en: I move between cabinet and cabinet.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就从后面绕回来。
lines.en: You back away, and I loop around behind you.

lines.zh: 我贴着箱底挪，指甲不出声。
lines.en: I slide along the crate bottom, nails silent.

lines.zh: 你抬头看架子，箱子是空的。
lines.en: You look up at the shelf; the crate is empty.

lines.zh: 我换到第二个箱子，你还没开。
lines.en: I move to the second crate before you open it.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的瞬间，我数到三。
lines.en: When you bend over, I count to three.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝就在我前面。
lines.en: Your ankle is right in front of me.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，暗处还够我藏。
lines.en: You raise the lamp; the dark still hides me.

lines.zh: 你一进三步，我尖叫着扑出。
lines.en: You reach three paces and I scream out of the chest.

lines.zh: 我整只撞到你脸上，又抓又咬。
lines.en: I hit your face all at once, clawing and biting.

lines.zh: 我的爪子留下三道口子。
lines.en: My claws leave three lines.

lines.zh: 尖叫声在你耳边炸开。
lines.en: My scream bursts right beside your ear.

lines.zh: 我从箱里弹出，落在你肩上。
lines.en: I spring from the chest and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我换到另一边。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I switch sides.

lines.zh: 你被打得后退，我落地就笑。
lines.en: You stumble back; I land laughing.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你手腕上。
lines.en: This bite lands on your wrist.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，撞得你仰倒。
lines.en: I leap and knock you onto your back.

lines.zh: 攻击完，我立刻找下一个箱子。
lines.en: Once done, I look for the next chest.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，但咬得很深。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they bite deep.

lines.zh: 我抓你眼睛，你偏头躲开。
lines.en: I go for your eyes; you turn your head away.

lines.zh: 我从背后扑上你的脖子。
lines.en: I pounce from behind onto your neck.

lines.zh: 你把我甩开，我笑着落地。
lines.en: You throw me off; I land laughing.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着从箱子里弹出来。
lines.en: I burst out of the crate screaming.

lines.zh: 你手上多了四道浅口子。
lines.en: Four shallow lines open on your hand.

lines.zh: 我趴在你背上，咬住衣领。
lines.en: I land on your back and bite your collar.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了半口气。
lines.en: That one took only half a breath.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，我笑着撞到墙上。
lines.en: You throw me off; I hit the wall laughing.

lines.zh: 你退到门口，我落在你肩上。
lines.en: You back to the door; I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从培养皿里爬出来，浑身湿。
lines.en: I crawl from the dish, soaked all over.

lines.zh: 实验室的灯灭时，我才出生。
lines.en: I was born when the lab lights went out.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一开始只有一小截。
lines.en: My tail started as a stub.

lines.zh: 玻璃碎了，我学会自己爬。
lines.en: The glass broke, and I learned to crawl.

lines.zh: 我在空荡的走廊里第一次笑。
lines.en: I first laughed in an empty corridor.

lines.zh: 记录里写着实验体，没写名字。
lines.en: The records say specimen, no name.

lines.zh: 我从通风管掉下来，摔在铁板上。
lines.en: I fell from the vent onto the iron floor.

lines.zh: 没人喂我，我就自己长。
lines.en: No one fed me, so I grew on my own.

lines.zh: 箱子成了我的第一张床。
lines.en: A chest became my first bed.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，只看见冷白的灯。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to cold white lamps.

lines.zh: 实验失败了，我却活着。
lines.en: The experiment failed, but I live.

lines.zh: 我缩在柜角，等第一个访客。
lines.en: I curl in the cabinet corner, waiting for the first visitor.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到我，我满地打滚。
lines.en: A flame touches me and I roll across the floor.

lines.zh: 我从箱顶跌下，尾巴垫了底。
lines.en: I drop from a chest top and land on my tail.

lines.zh: 水漫进箱子，笑声变成咕噜。
lines.en: Water fills the chest and my giggle turns to gurgling.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从箱子里掀出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the chest.

lines.zh: 箭头穿过我的尾巴，我尖叫。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my tail and I scream.

lines.zh: 药水的光钻进我眼睛，我发晕。
lines.en: Potion light gets in my eyes and I go dizzy.

lines.zh: 我从不吃，饿只是肚子贴背。
lines.en: I never eat; hunger is just belly against spine.

lines.zh: 雷响，我钻进最近的箱子。
lines.en: Thunder cracks and I dive into the nearest chest.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我还在找箱盖。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I still look for a lid.
